integrity: The infinite claim is proved by an explicit distance-difference case analysis.
Originality was checked by semantic database queries and by inspecting the foundational doubly-resolving paper and the directly relevant chain-graph metric-dimension paper.
No independence or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes at least two canonical levels and every canonical twin class has size at least two.
Singleton canonical classes can create additional interior obstructions and are not classified here.
The complete-bipartite case is excluded because it is the one-level case and is covered by broader complete-multipartite comparisons.
Finite exhaustive verification through order 12 supports the implementation but is not evidence for the infinite quantifier.
title: Doubly resolving sets of 2-thick chain graphs
